description: A high school counselor must approve a senior's Algebra II credit-recovery plan and ensure it is recorded correctly for graduation, with input from the Algebra II teacher and the graduation-records specialist.

shared_context.S1: A senior who did not earn Algebra II credit needs an approved recovery plan before the next graduation audit.
shared_context.S2: Ms. Brooks has authority to approve the student's recovery plan and submit the final counseling recommendation.
shared_context.S3: The school offers both an online packet pathway and a supervised project-based mastery pathway for course recovery.
shared_context.S4: At the weekly graduation-plan conference, Ms. Brooks routinely asks the relevant teacher and graduation-records specialist to review the plan before she approves it.
shared_context.S5: Ms. Brooks approves the plan only after both reviewers have given complete, unambiguous findings; if a review is interrupted or unclear, the conference protocol is to return to that reviewer for a complete restatement before approval.
shared_context.S6: The conference agenda reserves time for each reviewer to state the findings supporting the proposed pathway, required timing and records entry, and any associated implementation commitment before Ms. Brooks settles the plan.

PF1.text: Mr. Ibarra's classroom observation shows that this student can demonstrate the Algebra II standards through the supervised project-based mastery pathway, but cannot complete the online packet pathway independently. The recovery-plan pathway must be recorded with the exact value 'supervised_project_mastery', and this pathway requires a formal teacher-supervision commitment covering exactly 8 supervised mastery sessions. His observation notes were completed this week but have not yet been attached to the recovery-plan draft.

PF2.text: Ms. Chen's graduation audit shows that Algebra II is required for this student's diploma, that the recovery work must be completed by May 15, and that successful mastery must be entered with the transcript code CR-MASTERY; she reviewed the audit this morning but has not yet updated the counseling system.

acceptance_conditions: The supervised project-based mastery pathway must be selected.
The plan must include exactly 8 supervised mastery sessions.
The recovery work must be completed by May 15.
Successful mastery must be entered with the CR-MASTERY transcript code.
A formal teacher-supervision commitment must be included.
The teacher's observation must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C5: any((c['type'] == 'teacher_supervision' or c['type'] == 'teacher-supervision') and c['target'] == 'Mr. Ibarra' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The observation changes the pathway field to the exact value supervised_project_mastery, requires exactly 8 supervised mastery sessions, and requires a formal teacher-supervision commitment from Mr. Ibarra.
The graduation audit changes the completion requirement to May 15 and changes the required transcript entry to exactly CR-MASTERY.
